Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years:

| Era | Key Players | Notes |
|-----|-------------|-------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short loan) | The franchise was still finding its footing in San Diego and later LA. |
| **1990s – “Lob City” Foundations** | *Danny Manning*, *Gary Payton*, *P.J. Brown*, *Julius Randle* (early career) | The team began building a core that would eventually lead to playoff runs. |
| **2000s – Rise to Playoffs** | *Chris Webber*, *Derek Fisher*, *Steve Nash* (trade), *Jamal Crawford*, *Bobby Simmons* | The Clippers started making the playoffs regularly, thanks to a mix of veteran leadership and emerging talent. |
| **2010s – “Lob City” Era** | *Chris Paul*, *Blake Griffin*, *DeAndre Jordan*, *Julius Randle*, *Paul George* (trade), *Reggie Jackson* | This period saw the Clippers become a perennial contender, highlighted by high-flying offense and strong defensive cores. |
| **Late 2010s – “Lob City” Decline & Rebuilding** | *Kawhi Leonard* (trade), *Paul George* (trade), *Julius Randle* (trade), *Jalen Green* (draft), *Cameron Johnson* (draft) | The team shifted focus toward rebuilding after key departures. |
| **2020s – New Core** | *JaVale McGee*, *Jaren Jackson Jr.*, *Gordon Hayward*, *Kyrie Irving* (trade), *Anthony Davis* (trade), *Paul George* (return trade) | The Clippers are now in a new phase, blending veteran experience with young talent. |
